items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024

ctx.x: And King Oliver and some of those early records that, like with the Hot 5, they didn’t have any music they just knew the tunes and they knew how to sort of extrapolate on them.
